Data structures affected
- `## Processed source docs (94)` must become `95`, with `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08-2.md` added to the list.
- The aggregate summary sentence (`19 in-scope docs ...`) must be recalculated after classification.
- Add a new per-doc ledger subsection for `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08-2.md`.
- Keep recommendations source-doc-scoped because IDs like `MERGE-001` / `REUSE-001` repeat across dated docs.
- If any recommendation is truly obsolete/invalid, surface that explicitly in the new section so the issue’s acceptance criteria are met.

Plan
1. Normalize the source doc into unique recommendation outcomes.
   - Deduplicate repeated narrative recommendations that describe the same action.
   - Track the explicit audit IDs individually: `SEC-001`, `BUG-001`, `BUG-002`, `API-001..003`, `DUP-001..003`, `EXPR-001..004`, `DEAD-001`, `MERGE-001..002`, `REUSE-001..005`, `DEAD-API-001`.

2. Re-check each normalized item against current HEAD and classify it as one of:
   - Implemented by sibling work
   - Already satisfied / stale on this ref
   - Invalid / obsolete on this ref
   - Intentionally deferred, with rationale

3. For every implemented item, name the sibling issue/PR that landed it.
   - Those exact issue/PR numbers are not in the planning context, so implementation must derive them from tracking issue `#3243`, merged branch history, or the merged sibling PRs.

4. Update `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` with minimal-scope edits:
   - increment the processed-doc count and add the new bullet;
   - update the aggregate in-scope-doc/item counts;
   - append the new per-doc outcome block using the existing report convention;
   - add a short conflict/assumption note only if needed for deduping or count reconciliation.

5. Delete only `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08-2.md` in the same PR.

6. Leave `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt`, `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json`, and all other recommendation-processing artifacts unchanged.

API / interface changes
- None. This is a report closeout plus source-doc deletion only.

Risks / edge cases
- The source doc mixes repeated narrative recommendations with ID-tagged audit findings; avoid double-counting while still covering every unique recommendation.
- `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08-2.md` has an internal mismatch: the `NEEDS_VERIFICATION` summary row says `3` but lists four IDs (`REUSE-003`, `REUSE-005`, `API-001`, `API-002`). Record that if it affects counting.
- Some themes overlap with the already-processed `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08.md` section; mark those as already satisfied/stale instead of re-crediting them.
- The existing report heading `Outcome ledger for the 2026-05-15 through 2026-05-23 backlog docs` is already stale; avoid widening scope into historical heading cleanup unless necessary.
- Only delete the exact source doc named in this issue.

Testing considerations
- No runtime tests should be necessary if the change stays doc-only.
- Verify the new report section covers every normalized recommendation from the source doc.
- Verify the processed-doc count/list and aggregate counts are internally consistent.
- Verify `git diff --stat` shows only `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md` plus deletion of `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-08-2.md`.
- Verify the preserved machine-maintained artifacts remain untouched.
